title: Nginx Configuration Templates
shortDescription: Production-ready Nginx server blocks, reverse proxy configs, and security hardening templates.
longDescription:
A collection of battle-tested Nginx configuration templates for common web server scenarios. Each template includes detailed comments explaining every directive and the security implications.

Templates included:
- Basic static site server block
- Reverse proxy for Node.js/Python applications
- WebSocket proxy configuration
- TLS/SSL termination with Let's Encrypt
- Rate limiting and DDoS protection
- Caching strategies
- HTTP/2 and HTTP/3 support
- Security headers and CSP

All templates are production-ready and have been tested in high-traffic environments.
